ve_sacrifice_boon_desc: Boons from the Gods and Goddesses could ease your journey, but do not come for free.
ve_sacrifice_header_desc: Sacrifice to the Gods and Goddesses, rise to new heights and unviel new powers.
ve_prestige_header_desc: Reborn again, you will gain prestige and increase your challenge. Shed mortal knowledge, increase your rewards.
ve_oath_desc: Take on greater oaths, increase your challenge.
ve_gefjun_description: The goddess of agriculture, known as the generous one. With her guidance your harvests may be bountiful.
ve_baldur_description: The god of light and purity, known for his invulnerability. With his blessing light the darkest paths.
ve_freya_description: The goddess of love and war, a fierce and passionate deity. With her favor, may your battles be victorious.
ve_hel_description: The goddess of the underworld, balancer of life and death. With her power, may you find strength in the face of death.
ve_skaldi_description: The goddess of the hunt and winter. With her guidance, may your arrows strike true and storm be at your back.
ve_vor_description: The goddess of wisdom and curiosity. With her insight, may you see the path ahead clearly and avoid unseen dangers.
ve_syn_description: The goddess of defense and protection. Stand tall in the face of any foe.
ve_IncreasePickableYields_desc: Provides a chance to gain increased yields from harvestable plants.
ve_FishingProsperity_desc: Chance to gather bonus items when fishing
ve_HuntressArrowReturn: Chance to return arrows on use
ve_BrutalDefiance: Enables a shield bash with shields.
